_about: Map data for World_Map.html. One entry per solution page. status: active|upcoming. pins: real places named on the solution page (basis=page), launch site named on the page (basis=launch), or org headquarters when the page names no single site (basis=hq). strip: orbit = also listed in the From Orbit strip; world = worldwide, no single place (listed in the Worldwide strip). New solution? Add an entry here; build-map.py warns about any solution without one. Oct 15 (pins for all): space missions use the operating agency HQ or mission control (label says which). Natural systems and general concepts with no operating organization stay unpinned in the Worldwide/From Orbit strips.
